scene.note: The welcome screen stops being a page edited by hand and becomes App, built from smaller components.

steps.note: The page loads main.jsx, and today it draws nothing at all.
main.jsx makes a root on the page's root element and hands it App.
The welcome screen shows the museum's name.
Visitors ask when the museum is open.
A new component returns a section with a heading and one line about the hours.
The component can be drawn by itself, wherever a screen needs it.
Under the name, App uses OpeningHours as a tag.
The welcome screen shows the name, then the hours.
A component gives back the address line and the volunteers line.
App puts it inside the footer it already has.
The two lines sit at the bottom of the screen, with nothing extra around them.
